    • requestDocumentList

      public java.lang.Object requestDocumentList​(SearchParameter pSearchParam, ConnectionData pConnData, java.lang.String pTargetEndpoint, java.lang.String pOrganizationId)
      This method calls a method to query the document list.
      Specified by:
      requestDocumentList in interface ElgaConnection
      Parameters:
      pSearchParam - SearchParameter
      pConnData - ConnectionData, which includes the hcp assertion and the user id
      pTargetEndpoint - String targetEndpoint of the Service eBefunde like /elga-proxy/1/bereiche/ECS/XCA/eBefunde
      pOrganizationId - String id of the organization of the healthcare provider
      pPatientId - Identificator
      Returns:
      List of DocumentEntryResponseType if some documents are found, null if no documents are found

    • retrieveDocuments

      This method calls the method to retrieve documents
      Specified by:
      retrieveDocuments in interface ElgaConnection
      Parameters:
      pConnData - ConnectionData, which includes the hcp assertion and the user id
      pOrganizationId - String id of the organization of the healthcare provider
      pDocumentParameter - GetDocumentParameters have to include the unique ids of the required documents, the repository ids and the home community ids
      Returns:
      List of XDSDocuments if some documents are found, otherwise it will return null
